title: Microbiota–gut–brain axis damage in grass carp induced by nanoplastic and cadmium exposure: from cell injury to systemic response
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00242K, Paper
Chaonan Zhang, Chunping Mao, Qifeng Gao, Wenying Shen, Xiaodong Zhang, Daohui Lin
This study highlighted the toxic effects of NPs and Cd on the microbiota–gut–brain axis and swimming behavior of grass carp, providing new insights into the ecological risks posed by their co-occurrence in aquatic ecosystems.
